request.style: English, female voice, warm and reverent, solo with light choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, peaceful and majestic mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
God blessed them and said to them
Be fruitful and multiply
Fill the earth and subdue it
Rule over the sea and sky

[Verse]
Every seed-bearing plant on earth
Every tree with fruit and seed
They will be your food to eat
From the ground where you proceed

[Chorus]
God saw all that he had made
And behold, it was very good
The evening came, the morning rose
The sixth day stood as it should

[Verse]
To wild animals of the earth
To birds that fly in high
Green plants for their food to eat
Under the open sky

[Chorus]
God saw all that he had made
And behold, it was very good
The evening came, the morning rose
The sixth day stood as it should

[Bridge]
Everything that moves on ground
Has life within its frame
The garden and the field
All beauty in the name

[Outro]
And behold, it was very good
The sixth day was done
